ctx.x: That's the trumpet section. You're right, you're right. And, alright, that trumpet section. Well, that person, trombone. Earl Humphrey. Earl Humphrey at least, trombone. Yank Johnson trombone. And they had, I played baritone.
You remember that? That's the one when they got through the horn.
